finding.claim: The README description, the prototypes index entry and the log entry say "9 of its 17 claims elsewhere were real gaps", but the judge made 32 claims on negatives; 17 is only the gap plus false-alarm subset after 15 recorded-in-unit claims were set aside.

fixes.change: The description says 32 claims, 15 recorded in the unit and 10 of the other 17 gaps; a table of precision under other readings and how thin the margin is; the leak residue cites the words leak_check.py prints.
The log line gives the corrected claim counts.
